# Astronix Realty — Builder & Mandate Partner Portal

> The official developer and mandate platform of Astronix Realty, operating across Mumbai, Thane, Kalyan, and Dombivli (MMR). Enables RERA-registered real estate builders and exclusive sales mandate agencies to distribute verified inventory, access qualified homebuyer demand, and manage lead pipelines with real base-rate clarity.

## Platform Overview & Capabilities
- **Direct Developer Inventory Control**: Developers publish master layouts, tower approvals, wing progress, and carpet area cost sheets directly to the public marketplace (`https://astronixrealty.com`), eliminating duplicate listings and broker distortion.
- **Exclusive Mandate Management**: Dedicated tools for sole-selling agencies managing developer inventory, including team leader hierarchy routing, agent conversion analytics, and offer management.
- **₹111 Price Lock Guarantee Coordination**: Integration with the consumer ₹111 price lock guarantee, filtering casual inquiries into high-intent buyers with 72-hour price freeze commitments.
- **MahaRERA & Legal Safeguards**: Structured verification requiring MahaRERA Project Registration, Commencement Certificates (CC), and sanctioned architectural layouts.

## User Roles & Portal Access
- **Developers / Builders**: Master project creation, tower and wing management, pricing sheets, offer configurations, and direct buyer lead pipelines.
- **Exclusive Sales Mandates**: Assigned inventory tracking, subvention scheme coordination, team leader lead routing, and sales velocity metrics.
- **Sales Team Leaders**: Real-time agent activity monitoring, lead routing and re-assignment, and conversion tracking.

## Canonical Web Endpoints
- [Partner Portal Home](https://builder.astronixrealty.com): Platform overview, onboarding criteria, visible FAQs, and partner sign-up.
- [Partner Sign In](https://builder.astronixrealty.com/login): Enterprise authentication gateway for Builders, Mandates, and Team Leaders.
- [Partner Registration](https://builder.astronixrealty.com/register): Dual onboarding flow for Builders (`?type=builder`) and Mandates (`?type=mandate`).
- [Public Consumer Marketplace](https://astronixrealty.com): Primary buyer discovery portal for verified properties, floor plans, and price lock guarantees.

## Onboarding & Verification Criteria
1. Active MahaRERA Project Registration Number.
2. Sanctioned architectural layout plans and Commencement Certificate (CC).
3. Authorized signatory credentials and corporate entity documentation.
4. Commitment to zero fake listings and real base-rate pricing transparency.
